Ankara'dan İngiltere'ye ev eşyası taşımacılığı hakkında daha fazla bilgi için uzman ekibimizle iletişime geçebilirsiniz.
text.en:
Can I Move My Household Goods from Ankara to the UK?

Yes, Han Bros Cargo offers household goods shipping services from Ankara to the UK. We provide seamless transport with post-Brexit customs, packing and insured delivery plans.

Service Scope

  • Post-Brexit Customs: Procedures compliant with new customs regulations
  • Packing: Professional packing and packaging
  • Insured Delivery: Full insurance coverage
  • Seamless Transport: Direct transport from Ankara to the UK

More Information

You can contact our expert team for more information about moving household goods from Ankara to the UK.
